title: Reliable data clustering with Bayesian community detection
abstract: arXiv:2510.15013v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: From neuroscience and genomics to systems biology and ecology, researchers rely on clustering similarity data to uncover modular structure. Most methods work in two steps: first reduce noise, then cluster. The first step runs without regard to the second: it forces arbitrary choices, discards useful information, and can impose structure where none exists. Here we bring the two steps together. Using established Bayesian community detection methods, we let one minimum description length criterion choose both how much to sparsify the data and how to cluster it. This one-step approach keeps all the samples for inference, removes the arbitrary threshold choice, and returns a single cluster when there is no real structure. On synthetic data, our approach recovers clusters under more noise and with fewer samples than standard methods. translated_title: 基于贝叶斯社区发现的可靠数据聚类
translated_abstract: 从神经科学、基因组学到系统生物学和生态学，研究人员依靠对相似性数据进行聚类来揭示模块化结构。大多数方法分两步工作：先降低噪声，再进行聚类。第一步的执行并不考虑第二步的需求：这迫使研究者做出任意的选择，丢弃有用的信息，甚至可能在不存在真实结构的地方强行施加结构。本研究将这两个步骤结合在一起。利用成熟的贝叶斯社区检测方法，我们让单一的最小描述长度准则同时决定如何稀疏化数据以及如何聚类。这种一步式方法保留了全部样本用于推断，消除了任意阈值的选择，并在不存在真实结构时返回单一聚类。在合成数据上，我们的方法能够在更多噪声和更少样本的条件下恢复聚类，优于标准方法。在人脑基因共表达数据上，它找到了比现有方法更连贯、更稳定的聚类。
tldr: 该论文提出一种一步式聚类方法，利用贝叶斯社区检测和单一最小描述长度准则同时完成数据稀疏化与聚类，免除了任意阈值选择，在更高噪声和更少样本条件下优于传统两步法，且在无真实结构时能正确返回单一聚类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a one-step clustering method using Bayesian community detection, where a single minimum description length criterion governs both data sparsification and clustering, eliminating arbitrary threshold choices and outperforming standard two-step approaches under higher noise and fewer samples while correctly returning a single cluster when no real structure exists.
